04-09-1698 is September 4, 1698.  
Add 132 days:  
September has 30 days → 26 days left in September (30-4).  
132 - 26 = 106 days left.  
October (31), November (30), December (31) → 26+31+30+31=118 days by end of December.  
That overshoots, so instead: after September 26 days → October 31 → November 30 → that’s 26+31+30=87 days used.  
132 - 87 = 45 days left, into December. December 1 + 44 days = December 45? That’s wrong — December has 31 days, so 45 days from Dec 1 = Jan 14 next year (1699).  

Recalc properly:  
Sept 4 + 26 days = Sept 30.  
+ 31 days = Oct 31.  
+ 30 days = Nov 30.  
+ 31 days = Dec 31 (total so far 26+31+30+31=118 days).  
132 - 118 = 14 days into 1699 → Jan 14, 1699.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1699-01-14
